title: commit-to-main verify-merged holds a GitHub runner idle while its PR waits on CI
note: From GH-CAPACITY-INFRA-FIRST. MEASURED 2026-10-15: research-queue-dispatch (hourly cron) last completed run spent 33 runner-min in three commit-to-main 'land' steps (13+7+13) waiting for its own PRs to merge; those PRs need pytest-run slots from the same 20-job pool, so a waiting research job lengthens the queue it is waiting on. 37 workflow uses of .github/actions/commit-to-main; verify-timeout up to 80 min (W41). Proposal: open the PR + arm auto-merge in-run, and move the merged-or-not verification to the NEXT scheduled cycle (or a short follow-up job), keeping the 'opened != on main' property. Rerun: gh api runs of research-queue-dispatch.yml -> per-step minutes of the land job.  | DESIGN NOTE 2026-10-15: research-queue-dispatch has 3 commit-to-main calls, all verify-merged "true" (results batch, liveness receipt, dispatch stamps), and the results-batch call is followed by "Assert every batched record is readable on main", which depends on the merge. .github/actions/commit-to-main/action.yml is in check_pr_landing LANDING_MACHINERY, so changing the action cannot self-land. Lowest-risk first step (caller-only, Tier 1): liveness receipt -> verify-merged false, with the NEXT cycle's liveness check (check_research_queue_dispatch_liveness.py) asserting the previous receipt reached main (7 runner-min/run saved). Stamps: the dispatcher already treats a unit stamped by an OPEN stamp PR as dispatched (--check-open-stamp-prs), so the merged-wait is redundant for double-fire safety; needs a test proving a never-merging stamp PR is detected (stranded-stamp adoption exists, STRANDED_STAMP_HOURS). Results batch: move the readable-on-main assert to the next cycle's collect step.
